success_metric.name: Qualified coded B2B inquiries per staff hour (4-week should-we-do-social test)
success_metric.how_measured: Each video gets its own WhatsApp code. Coded chats are counted from the weekly WhatsApp export, and phone/rep inquiries are logged as «откуда узнали?» answers. A coded inquiry counts as qualified if it names the company or ИП, the material and an approximate volume. Staff minutes come from completed shoot cards. Whether an inquiry reached an offer or invoice comes from a yes/no tag added by the rep.
success_metric.target: Over 4 weeks: conservative 2 / expected 5 / stretch 10 qualified coded inquiries. At about 80 planned staff minutes, that is roughly 1.5 / 3.5 / 7.5 per staff hour. Baseline: unknown, because there is no export or social account yet. The week-0 count of all inbound company inquiries (phone and WhatsApp, 2026-10-12 → 2026-10-18) becomes the baseline. Verdict threshold, set in advance: YES if at least 3 are qualified and at least 1 reaches an offer or invoice (default until the owner answers Q1).

leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ platform median: the pooled b2b_construction_materials median until the account has 10 posts of its own, then its own last-15 median
Shares + saves per 1,000 views (forwarding to a foreman or colleague is the B2B share signal)
Coded WhatsApp chats per 1,000 views, all of them before the qualification filter
Profile visits per 1,000 views (procurement and new contractors check legitimacy here before the first order)
constraints: BUDGET: 0 ₸ for the whole test. No boost, so the verdict reflects organic reach only. A boost of a proven post can come later as a separate, owner-approved arm (default + judgment)
OWNER: ≤15 min onboarding, ≤5 min/week, one batched message. The owner is skeptical, so the weekly report is 5 lines or fewer with true numbers only (default + stated skepticism)
STAFF: ≤17 planned min/week (20 including safety), one phone, audio usable only within about 30 cm (stated)

FILMING: hands, bags, mixing, pallets, loading, trucks and voice only. No faces. No customer sites, customer workers, company logos on site or vehicle plates without consent; blur them otherwise (default)
PRICES: none in content. The ledger is empty and B2B prices are assumed to be quote-based (default)
CAPACITY: unknown. No «в наличии», «доставим завтра», delivery-radius, minimum-order or lead-time claims until confirmed in the ledger (default)

REGULATED: not a listed regulated category. Judgment: technical and safety specs (морозостойкость, теплопроводность, расход на м², ГОСТ, класс горючести) appear only verbatim from manufacturer datasheets stored in the ledger with a URL or file. No outcome promises about the finished building (judgment)
AVOID: politics, religion, ethnicity, mocking customers or brigades, naming competitors, naming clients, tender details (default + judgment: B2B confidentiality)

ACCOUNTS: none known (profile.social is empty). The agent searches for existing Instagram/TikTok/YouTube/2GIS presence. Creating accounts and claiming the 2GIS card are owner asks. Business accounts use commercial-library music only (evidence + default)

APPROVAL: the owner approves each weekly batch explicitly. Account creation, any face on camera, offers, spend and any contact with existing clients (Status or broadcast) always need explicit approval (default)
GUARDRAIL: median first WhatsApp reply ≤15 min in working hours (default)
GUARDRAIL: no time taken from sales reps or the tender process beyond the 20 staff min/week (judgment)
GUARDRAIL: inquiries from private individuals are routed under the owner's rule (Q2) and never counted as qualified (judgment)
assumptions: VERDICT (pre-registered, judgment, because the METHOD does not define a B2B qualification rule): YES = qualified coded inquiries at or above the threshold (default 3) AND at least 1 reaches an offer or invoice → next sprint becomes b2b_leads. NO = below the threshold with at least 15 posts published → stop making video; keep only the 2GIS card and a static profile as a shop window (≈0 min/week). INCONCLUSIVE = fewer than 15 posts published (an execution failure, not a market answer) → extend 2 weeks once. The verdict is announced on 2026-11-16 whatever the result.

SECONDARY: b2b_leads, a qualified pipeline. It applies only if the verdict is YES and gets no slots in this test beyond conversion CTAs. Shorts alone are weak for B2B, so direct outreach by reps (sending the best videos to existing contacts) is flagged as the stronger lever and tracked as a separately coded arm, not counted in the 'new inquiries' verdict.

SECONDARY: shop-window legitimacy. Procurement and new contractors may check the supplier's Instagram or 2GIS before a first order. This value is invisible to codes, so reps ask «смотрели наш профиль/ролики?» on new calls. It is reported as directional only.

BOTTLENECK: unknown, low confidence, no evidence (the ledger and files are empty). Working hypothesis: awareness among small and mid-size contractors and brigades that the reps do not reach. Alternative: there is no marketing bottleneck at all, because sales run on reps and tenders. That alternative is exactly what the test checks. Step 2 checks for a disguised conversion problem (reply time, where chats die).

REALISM: target 5 qualified. Assuming [ASSUMPTION] 50% of coded chats are qualified, req_chats ≈ 10. req_views = 10 ÷ (0.3–3 per 1k, [ASSUMPTION] 10× range) ≈ 3.3k–33k. ach_views = 20 posts (5/week × 4) × [ASSUMPTION] 300-view median for a new B2B account in one city × 1.8 ≈ 10.8k. ratio 0.3–3.1 → feasible to stretch, with very wide uncertainty. New accounts are a cold start, and a one-city B2B audience is small. Replace these numbers after week 2.

[ASSUMPTION] For small and mid-size orders the person who makes first contact is a foreman or brigade lead; procurement mostly handles large orders and tenders | if wrong (procurement only): content shifts to documents, specs and delivery reliability, short video is weaker, a NO is likely, and reps' direct outreach becomes the main lever | verify: 15–30 chat WhatsApp export plus a rep tally of who calls, in step 2, by 2026-10-16

[ASSUMPTION] The company has no social accounts (profile.social is empty) | if wrong: past posts set the baseline and are re-cut as zero-minute ideas | verify: agent search of Instagram/TikTok/YouTube/2GIS by 2026-10-12

[ASSUMPTION] The warehouse and trucks have free capacity for more small and mid-size orders | if wrong: conversion CTAs are throttled (DR10) and the test measures trust only | verify: money map in step 2 (owner, 2 min)

[ASSUMPTION] Seasonality: the test runs at the end of the outdoor season in Karaganda, so facade and exterior demand is likely falling while interior finishing and insulation continue. Content leans toward interior work | if wrong: none | verify: compare inquiry counts with the same weeks last year if the owner has them. A NO in November means 'no for this winter', and a spring re-test is offered, not assumed.

[ASSUMPTION] Production: 5 posts a week fit in ≤17 staff minutes because warehouse realities (pouring, mixing, stacking, loading) are short close-sound shots at 1–2 locations, plus zero-minute AI edits | if wrong: drop to 3 posts a week, keep the 15-post minimum for the verdict, extend by 1 week | verify: staff reality scan in week 0

JUDGMENT: METHOD gap. 'Qualified' for B2B is defined here as naming the company or ИП, the material and an approximate volume (A2 b2b_leads wording). Inquiries that miss one element are counted but reported separately.
clarifying_questions: Здравствуйте, это AI-ассистент. Через 4 недели решаем: продолжать соцсети или нет. Сколько новых обращений от компаний по коду из ролика (с названием компании, материалом и объёмом) за 4 недели для вас будет означать «да, стоит»? 1 — 3 и больше, 2 — 6 и больше, 3 — 10 и больше. По умолчанию: 1, и хотя бы одно из них должно дойти до КП или счёта. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.

Кого считаем клиентом из роликов: 1 — только юрлица с договором, 2 — ещё ИП, бригады и прорабы с оплатой по счёту, 3 — всех, включая частных покупателей? По умолчанию: 2, а частников вежливо направляем по вашему правилу. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.
Кого можно снимать на складе: 1 — только руки, мешки, погрузку, машины и голос, 2 — ещё сотрудников с лицом (только с их согласия)? По умолчанию: 1. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.

If the export shows replies over 60 minutes, that is the leak to fix before content. Rejected sibling: a price_pressure insight («у других дешевле»), dropped because there are no prices or comparison data (E26).

insights.who_feels_it: An ИП or brigade lead with a mid-size order who is not on any rep's account list, messaging from a site in the evening.

We can show the manufacturer's own bag label on camera and do the arithmetic on paper with hands, quoting only what the filmed label says. This moves inquiries because the natural next step is «пришлите площадь — посчитаем». HYPOTHESIS (E16): calculation questions not yet counted. Rejected sibling: a myth insight «все смеси одинаковые», dropped because testing it needs datasheets and invites comparative claims (E19).

insights.who_feels_it: A foreman pricing a plaster, screed or tile-adhesive job by m² for a client who will not pay for a second delivery.

We can show how bags are actually stored and handled (on pallets, wrapped, a hand pressing a bag to show it is loose), only what the camera sees. This moves trust before the first order and the offer/invoice step of the verdict. HYPOTHESIS (E15): damage complaints not yet counted. insights.tension: Wants usable bags on arrival, but fears damp, caked or torn stock and the embarrassment of rejecting a load on site.
insights.who_feels_it: A brigade lead taking a delivery on site who answers to the site owner for every wasted bag.

insights.who_feels_it: A contractor in Karaganda whose outdoor jobs end with the first frost and who is lining up interior and insulation work for November–March.

insights.insight: [job] When a procurement officer or a contractor new to this supplier is about to place a first order, they want proof the supplier is real: a warehouse, trucks, documents. insights.tension: Outsider curiosity (nobody hears this from outside) versus the risk of being an attention-only arm with no B2B buyer link.

insights.content_reality: «склад»: bag drop, pallet wrap and mixer, each 6–12 s, phone at 20–30 cm, no speech. Zero claims. The inventory is unconfirmed until the staff reality scan.

insights.tension: Wants to look open to everyone, versus the real cost of serving tiny private orders. Honesty about the limit may raise B2B trust.
insights.who_feels_it: A private homeowner after a few bags (filtered out) and a contractor who reads the filter as a sign of seriousness.

Rejected sibling: a price_pressure insight («у других дешевле»), dropped because there are no prices or comparison data (E26).
insights.tension: Wants a quick per-site quote, but expects big-supplier slowness, so shops around and takes the first answer.
insights.who_feels_it: An ИП or brigade lead with a mid-size order who is not on any rep's account list, messaging from a site in the evening.
insights.content_reality: «тихий угол»: hands on the phone typing an anonymised reply, voice-over at 30 cm. Only questions really received may be shown, paraphrased («Нам пишут: …») after 2 or more matching chats. Until the export arrives → question and recognition content only.

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] When estimating a job, a foreman wants to order the right number of bags once. He works from area × the consumption printed on the bag, and a wrong layer thickness or wastage assumption means a second delivery (crew idle) or paid-for leftovers, so he rounds up heavily or runs out mid-job. We can show the manufacturer's own bag label on camera and do the arithmetic on paper with hands, quoting only what the filmed label says. This moves inquiries because the natural next step is «пришлите площадь — посчитаем». HYPOTHESIS (E16): calculation questions not yet counted. Rejected sibling: a myth insight «все смеси одинаковые», dropped because testing it needs datasheets and invites comparative claims (E19).
insights.tension: Wants to order once and exactly, but the label-based estimate is error-prone, so he over-orders or runs short.
insights.who_feels_it: A foreman pricing a plaster, screed or tile-adhesive job by m² for a client who will not pay for a second delivery.
insights.content_reality: «склад» or «тихий угол»: close-up of a real bag label + hands writing the sum on cardboard. A proof asset only after the label is filmed (E17). No consumption numbers in copy until the label or datasheet is in the ledger → NEEDS FACT for every figure.

insights.insight: [proof] When material is delivered to site, the foreman wants bags he can use straight away. He fears damp, caked or torn bags that he will have to reject in front of the crew, so he inspects every bag, refuses whole loads or sticks with one known yard. We can show how bags are actually stored and handled (on pallets, wrapped, a hand pressing a bag to show it is loose), only what the camera sees. This moves trust before the first order and the offer/invoice step of the verdict. HYPOTHESIS (E15): damage complaints not yet counted. Storage claims are limited to what is visibly filmed (the camera verifies).
insights.tension: Wants usable bags on arrival, but fears damp, caked or torn stock and the embarrassment of rejecting a load on site.
insights.who_feels_it: A brigade lead taking a delivery on site who answers to the site owner for every wasted bag.
insights.content_reality: «склад»: hand pressing a sealed bag, pallet under film, close sound of the wrap. Visible storage only. NO claims of «сухой склад», «отапливаемый» or «не бывает комков» until owner-confirmed and filmed.

insights.insight: [moment] When the first frosts come to Karaganda in late October, brigades move indoors and plan winter interior finishing and insulation. They want to keep the crew working, but they are unsure what can be stored, mixed or applied in the cold, so they delay orders or ask around on site. We can show the question being taken seriously and the manufacturer's label or datasheet line being read on camera, with no temperature promise of our own. This moves coded inquiries timed to the test window. HYPOTHESIS (E18): a seasonal pattern from regional knowledge, with no inquiry data by week. A NO verdict in November means 'no for this winter'.
insights.tension: Wants to keep the brigade busy through winter, but is unsure which materials and conditions work in the cold.
insights.who_feels_it: A contractor in Karaganda whose outdoor jobs end with the first frost and who is lining up interior and insulation work for November–March.
insights.content_reality: «склад»: frost or snow visible at the warehouse door + hands turning a bag to the storage-conditions line on the label. NO PROOF → question format only («Нам пишут: …»). Every temperature or морозостойкость statement is a NEEDS FACT from the datasheet.

insights.insight: [job] When a procurement officer or a contractor new to this supplier is about to place a first order, they want proof the supplier is real: a warehouse, trucks, documents. They fear paying up front to a reseller with no stock, so they stay with known suppliers or ask for references. We can show the real warehouse and the paperwork ritual at handover (documents in hand, details blurred). This moves the offer/invoice half of the verdict and profile visits, though not coded chats (directional only). HYPOTHESIS (E22): shop-window value comes from the intake SECONDARY and is unmeasured by codes.
insights.tension: Wants to try a new supplier, but fears an unverifiable middleman, so defaults to known suppliers.
insights.who_feels_it: A procurement officer or a growing contractor checking a supplier's Instagram or 2GIS card before the first invoice.
insights.content_reality: «склад» / «погрузка»: real pallets, truck loading, hands passing a folder of documents with details blurred. No «официальный дилер», certificate names or years-on-market claims until they are ledger facts.

insights.insight: [identity] When something goes wrong on site (material late, wrong quantity, a crack after drying), the foreman takes the blame from the client even when the supplier caused it. He wants a supplier who understands that pressure but rarely feels understood, so he sticks with whoever has not let him down yet. We can name his situation in his own words as text over real warehouse footage (labelled POV), never mocking brigades or clients. This builds recognition and shares among foremen, which is the B2B share signal. HYPOTHESIS: no counted language yet (E14, E27); hook vocabulary must come from the chat export.
insights.tension: Wants to be seen as reliable by his client, but carries the blame for supplier failures he cannot control.
insights.who_feels_it: A foreman or brigade lead juggling 2–3 Karaganda sites who is the client's single point of blame.
insights.content_reality: «склад» / «погрузка»: real loading and pallet footage with on-screen POV text, labelled «POV». Recognition content only. No faces (E21), no client sites.

insights.insight: [content_reality] Outsiders never hear a building-materials warehouse up close: a 25 kg bag landing on a pallet, stretch film squealing around a stack, a drill mixer biting into a fresh batch. These close sounds are what a weak phone at 30 cm records best, and they break the hypothesised catalogue-photo convention (E23). They exist as cheap, high-variance reach shots and as the visual bed for I01–I07. The tension is only curiosity («снаружи этого никто не слышит»). The link to inquiries is weak and indirect (follows, profile visits), and E12 warns that demos without a buyer question tend to under-perform, so each sound clip should carry a buyer-question caption.
insights.tension: Outsider curiosity (nobody hears this from outside) versus the risk of being an attention-only arm with no B2B buyer link.
insights.who_feels_it: Any trade worker or curious local scrolling Reels or TikTok in Karaganda. The buyer is reached only incidentally.
insights.content_reality: «склад»: bag drop, pallet wrap and mixer, each 6–12 s, phone at 20–30 cm, no speech. Zero claims. The inventory is unconfirmed until the staff reality scan.

insights.insight: [tension] WILDCARD (honest_signal): when someone needs only a few bags, they want a quick, cheap answer, but a company-only supplier wastes their time and the supplier's. Saying openly who should NOT contact this supplier (and where they are better served) is an against-interest signal that real contractors may trust more, and it filters private callers before they consume reply time (E24). It is thin: the minimum-order or routing rule is unknown, so the idea cannot be made until the owner answers Q2 and states a rule.
insights.tension: Wants to look open to everyone, versus the real cost of serving tiny private orders. Honesty about the limit may raise B2B trust.
insights.who_feels_it: A private homeowner after a few bags (filtered out) and a contractor who reads the filter as a sign of seriousness.
insights.content_reality: «тихий угол»: hands, voice-over at 30 cm, real pallets in the background. NO RULE YET → blocked by NEEDS FACT: minimum order or private-buyer routing rule (owner, Q2). No anti_sell claim until then.

output.name: «Склад как есть»: 4-week should-we-do-social test (Karaganda, B2B dry mixes and insulation)
output.big_idea: A contractor who has never met a rep can't judge a supplier from catalogue photos, but he can judge a real warehouse. So we show the actual bag label read aloud, the actual pallet being wrapped and the actual first WhatsApp message a foreman sends, and every episode ends in one coded message that names the company, the material and the volume. Each of the ~40 SKU labels, each recurring foreman question and each warehouse ritual is an episode, so the idea yields well over 20 episodes. Each is provable on camera because the camera verifies what it films. Each points at the measured action: a qualified coded inquiry.
output.single_minded_message_ru: Смотрите склад, а не картинки из каталога
output.why_this_wins:
This plan does not forecast that the test will succeed. It is designed so that it gives an honest answer either way.

**Why it is built this way**
1. **Every insight is a hypothesis.** All of I01–I09 are capped at strength 2 or lower: the ledger and files are empty, and chats have not been counted yet (E13, E28). So the campaign makes no claims. It shows only what the camera verifies: labels (E17), pallets and wrap (E20), and the typing ritual (I02). This keeps every post truthful while the ledger is still empty.
2. **The message challenges the hypothesised category convention** of catalogue photos and price slides (E23, L005). L006 says demos without a buyer question under-perform. So every warehouse clip carries a foreman's question or ends in the coded CTA.

**Why the hero is «Читаем мешок» rather than I01 (judgment; the METHOD says to put the hero on the top insight)**
- I01, the idle crew waiting on a late truck, is ranked first, but it cannot be resolved truthfully. There is no timing, radius or reliability fact (E26). Any 'resolution' would be an invented promise.
- I03/I05, reading what the manufacturer prints on the bag, is the strongest tension we can actually prove on camera this week (E16, E17, E19).
- I01 still runs, but as recognition content only (ID10 POV).

**Learning plan**
- 20 base posts across 7 drivers and 8 formats, all in the shared slugs, so the results feed the pooled b2b_construction_materials priors.
- The pre-registered verdict, written down before posting starts: qualified coded inquiries ≥3 (default) AND at least 1 reaches an offer or invoice. It is judged per staff hour.
- An INCONCLUSIVE branch for fewer than 15 posts, so that an execution failure is never read as a market answer.
- Shop-window value (I06, E22) is tracked separately through the reps' «смотрели профиль?» tally. It is labelled directional and is never counted toward YES.

series.name: Читаем мешок
series.role: HERO. Consideration → conversion. Metric: saves/1k and qualified coded chats/1k. Opening ritual: a hand stops a common site shortcut mid-action, cut to a finger on the bag's label line, and the fixed hook ending «…? Читаем мешок». Fixed structure: shortcut (labelled «постановка») → label read verbatim → close-sound result → CTA «материал и объём». The episode variable is the SKU or the label line: water ratio, storage, mixing time, layer, consumption. Each episode needs ≤4 staff min: the talk line is recorded at the склад corner with the phone at the mouth, so it uses 1 location. Ep. 7 test: «Расход на м²? Читаем мешок»; a stranger could guess it and would still watch. Every figure is a NEEDS FACT until the filmed label is in the ledger.
series.cadence: 1 in week 1 (ID13), then 2 per week in weeks 2–4 as new SKU episodes of the ID13 template. Thompson allocation can cut this from week 3.

Episodes use only questions confirmed in ≥2 real chats from the export, paraphrased. ID14, the message template, is pinned as the «как заказать» post.

Cheap cross-post plus a search tail.
- Optional plain titles naming the material type and the city, but only material names actually shown on camera (no brand or spec claims). Long-form-style titles are not assumed to help (L003).

Where the verdict is counted.
- **Codes:** each video has its own {CODE}. It is on screen for ≥2 s, in the caption and in the pinned comment. The code is not spoken (no faces, voice optional).
- **Quick reply** (approved once by the owner): «Здравствуйте! Вы по видео {CODE}. Подскажите, пожалуйста: компания или ИП, какой материал и примерный объём — передадим менеджеру, он ответит по наличию и условиям.»

- **Private buyers:** a polite reply following the owner's Q2 rule. Counted separately, never as qualified.

measurement.success_metric:
Qualified coded B2B inquiries per staff hour over the 4-week test (2026-10-19 → 2026-11-15).
- **Qualified** means the inquiry names the company or ИП, the material and an approximate volume. Partial inquiries are counted and reported separately. Private buyers are never qualified.
- **Target:** conservative 2 / expected 5 / stretch 10 qualified, about 1.5 / 3.5 / 7.5 per staff hour at ~80 planned staff minutes.
- **Baseline:** the week-0 count of all inbound company inquiries (2026-10-12 → 10-18). The ratio target is fixed as a multiple at the end of week 2.
- **Pre-registered verdict on 2026-11-16:** YES = ≥3 qualified (the default until the owner answers Q1) AND ≥1 reaches an offer or invoice.
measurement.attribution:
- **Per-video WhatsApp codes**, assigned by code: on screen ≥2 s, in the caption and in the pinned comment, plus a prefilled wa.me link with a bio code in the Instagram bio. Coded chats are reported as a floor, because codes undercount.
- **Estimate:** weekly total inbound company inquiries (phone and WhatsApp) vs the week-0 baseline. Labelled an estimate, because one week of baseline is thin.
- **Reps:** on new calls they ask «Откуда узнали? Смотрели профиль/ролики?» and keep a tally. Directional shop-window evidence that is never counted toward YES.
- **Rep forwarding and Status:** chats from these use separate code families and are excluded from the new-inquiry verdict.
- **Offer or invoice:** a yes/no tag added by the rep on each qualified chat.
- **Staff minutes:** from completed shoot cards.
- **Attribution window:** 30 days per code. Inquiries that arrive after 11-15 are reported in an addendum and do not change the 11-16 verdict.
- **Kaspi:** not applicable (B2B, not listed).
leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ platform median, as a log ratio per engine. Uses the pooled b2b_construction_materials median ([ASSUMPTION] 300 views if none exists) until the account has 10 posts of its own on that platform
3-second hold and average % watched vs the account median
Shares + saves per 1,000 views (a forward to a foreman or procurement colleague is the B2B share signal)
Comments per 1,000 views (these feed ID21 replies and the I01/I07 evidence)
Coded WhatsApp chats per 1,000 views (all chats, before the qualification filter), plus the share that is qualified
measurement.review_cadence:
- 48 h read per post (allocation) and 7-day read per post (final).
- Weekly campaign read every Monday, with a 5-line Russian owner report.
- Week-2 checkpoint: replace the REALISM assumptions with measured medians and chats per 1k.
- Verdict review on 2026-11-16.
- Code attribution window: 30 days.

decision_rules: DR1 Read: every post at 48 h and at 7 days, on each platform against its own baseline.

DR2 Breakout: ≥3× the platform median at 48 h (≈ ≥900 views on the 300-view [ASSUMPTION], replaced by the own last-15 median after 10 posts), or shares+saves/1k ≥2× the median.
- Within 7 days, 2 follow-ups: a part 2 or the same insight in a new format, plus a reply to the top comment. They replace planned slots, so the staff budget stays ≤17 min.
- Pin the post if it is conversion-relevant. WhatsApp Status only with the owner's approval. No boost during the test (0 ₸).
- At ≥10× (≈ ≥3,000 views) it becomes a series, and the owner hears «вирусный» as a tail event, not a plan.
DR3 Hook failure: 3-s hold <0.7× the account median → re-cut with a different first frame and hook, repost ≥7 days later, once only.
DR4 Body failure: hold OK but completion <0.7× the median → shorten and move the payoff earlier in the next episode. No repost as is.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss: by the end of week 3, cumulative views on plan (≥ ~8,000 across platforms) but coded chats <30% of plan (fewer than 2) → before more content, check the CTA visibility, the code in the caption and pinned comment, the bio wa.me link and the reply time. Only then propose the non-price offer to the owner.
Reply guardrail: median first WhatsApp reply in working hours >60 min → reported to the owner as the top leak, and conversion pieces are paused until it is ≤15 min.
DR6 Sales-handling miss: ≥3 qualified coded inquiries but 0 reach an offer or invoice → report where those chats died and draft reply scripts. Price and terms stay the owner's call.
DR7 Attention-only arm: from week 3, a reach arm (Склад слышно, POV) with ≥3 posts, ≥3,000 views and 0 coded chats while another arm has ≥1 qualified chat → capped at 1 post a week.
Private buyers: if they are more than 50% of coded chats for 2 weeks running → add the owner's routing line to captions and the quick reply. They are never counted as qualified.

DR10 Capacity: capacity is unknown. If reps report they cannot process qualified inquiries within 1 working day, or the owner says the trucks or warehouse are full → pause conversion CTAs and shift to trust content.
DR11 Honesty kill-switch: a comment credibly disputes a fact (for example a label reading) → pause that series, verify against the ledger, and tell the owner the same day.
DR13 Claims: no arm is called a 'winner' this sprint (n<10 per arm). Report «лидирует, рано судить» with an interval.
DR14 Staff: card completion <80% for 2 weeks → drop to 3 posts a week, face-free short takes and fewer locations. Keep the 15-post minimum and extend the test by 1 week.
DR15 Owner: rejections >30% of a batch → read the reasons and update the constraints. A fact rejection means fixing the ledger.
DR16: never delete flops, except for truth, consent or legal problems.

VERDICT (pre-registered, 2026-11-16):
- **YES:** qualified coded inquiries ≥ the threshold (default 3) AND ≥1 offer or invoice → the next sprint is b2b_leads, and a boost arm may be proposed.
- **NO:** below the threshold with ≥15 posts published → stop video; keep the 2GIS card and a static profile (≈0 min/week); offer a spring re-test.
- **INCONCLUSIVE:** fewer than 15 posts published → extend by 2 weeks, once.
- The result is reported whatever it is.

output.persona: Owner of a B2B building-materials supplier in Karaganda (dry mixes, insulation). Sceptical of social media. Sells through sales reps and tenders. I asked whether we need social media at all.
output.best_idea: The core of the plan is sound. You don't argue about whether social media works; you run a 0 ₸ test for 4 weeks, with a YES/NO threshold set in advance, a separate WhatsApp code for each video, and a promise to say «не нужно» if the numbers don't come. Two parts are actually useful to me even if video fails. First, the reply-time check in WhatsApp (if a first reply takes over 60 minutes, that is the main leak, not the content). Second, the plan admits that reps forwarding videos is the stronger lever for B2B. My best pick is ID14, "how to write to get a quote fast". It works as a template for incoming requests even with no audience at all.

refutations.target: Staff time limit of 20 min/week and «не отнимаем время у менеджеров»
refutations.why_fails: The 20 minutes only covers the shoot card. On top of that come: the tally sheet at the gate (~1 min a day, not a week, if every truck gets a mark), the weekly voice note «3 вопроса», «Видео» and «КП/счёт» labels on every chat, reps asking «откуда узнали / смотрели профиль?» and keeping a tally, tagging offers and invoices, and replying to WhatsApp within 15 minutes. That last one is a sales rep's job, and nobody has counted it. In practice it is 1–2 hours a week of reps' and the desk's time, which breaks the plan's own rule about not taking time from reps. The verdict is calculated 'per staff hour' from the cards only, so it will flatter the result.
refutations.fix: Count ALL minutes (cards plus tally, labels, reply desk, rep questions) in one sheet and calculate the verdict from that total. Cut what isn't needed: drop the truck tally (ID17) and keep only one label per chat.

refutations.target: Owner time: ≤15 min onboarding, ≤5 min/week
refutations.why_fails: The owner_asks list adds up to 1+1+1+3+3+2+2 = 13 minutes on paper. In reality that means creating three accounts, verifying a 2GIS card, exporting chats, agreeing reply templates and briefing the reps, which is easily an hour or more. The deadline is 10.10 at 12:00, and today is 10.09. Week 0 starts on 10.12 and expects accounts, a baseline and the label texts in the ledger to be ready by then. The schedule is not realistic, and the plan itself admits that a slip pushes the test to INCONCLUSIVE.
refutations.fix: Give me 3 working days to answer. Shift the whole timeline by 1 week (posts from 10.26). Start with Instagram plus 2GIS only and add TikTok and YouTube after week 2 if Instagram shows life.

refutations.target: WhatsApp export request: «Имена и номера удаляем сразу, наружу ничего не попадает»
refutations.why_fails: That isn't true. The export of my clients' chats goes to an AI service, so it leaves the company. The chats hold prices, terms and project details, which are commercial secrets of my clients and of my firm. I can't sign off on this wording, and if a client found out it would be embarrassing.
refutations.fix: Say it honestly: «чаты обрабатывает ИИ-сервис, мы удаляем имена/номера/цены до анализа». Even better: a rep exports and anonymises the chats himself (delete prices and names) and sends 15 of them. Or skip the export and use a list of the 10 most common questions written by a rep.

refutations.target: ID07 and ID19 (frost on the stretch film, at the door, on our pallets)
refutations.why_fails: For a supplier of dry mixes and insulation, showing frost and snow on our own stock is shooting ourselves in the foot. A contractor sees 'they keep material in the cold or outside'. Even if that's fine for these products, the comments will say «у вас смесь промёрзла». The risk is to our reputation, not a gain.
refutations.fix: Shoot frost only outside the warehouse (the yard, the gate, the sky) and the stock only in a dry, warm room. Or drop ID19 and keep ID07 without frost on our pallets.

refutations.target: ID10 POV «бригада на объекте, а машины нет»
refutations.why_fails: A supplier who has no confirmed facts about how reliable its deliveries are is reminding its audience of the pain of late deliveries. That invites comments like «а от вас я ждал 3 часа». Real complaints in public are the very embarrassment the plan promises to avoid.
refutations.fix: Don't publish until delivery facts are in the ledger and the owner says «да». Otherwise replace it with a POV that has nothing to do with deliveries.

refutations.target: ID13 «Воду на глаз? Читаем мешок» and the whole hero series
refutations.why_fails: For a professional foreman this is teaching him basic things he does every day, which comes across as condescending. Reading the manufacturer's label aloud adds nothing that comes from us; he can read the bag himself. The plan's own brand_link score is 3. As the hero of a campaign meant to bring B2B inquiries, it is weak. Opening a bag to film also costs product.
refutations.fix: Make the hero «Вопрос из WhatsApp»/ID14 (lowest effort, closest to the request itself). Keep «Читаем мешок» for one or two episodes as a test, not as the hero.

refutations.target: ID17 «сколько машин ушло за неделю»
refutations.why_fails: This publishes sales volume to competitors. If the number is small it looks weak. It also adds the daily tally chore. It doesn't help the verdict (objective_fit 2).
refutations.fix: Remove it from the test.

refutations.target: Verdict logic: 4 weeks on a NEW account → «NO = прекратить видео»
refutations.why_fails: The plan itself assumes ~300 views per post and a range of 0.3–3 chats per 1,000 views, so the most likely outcome is 0–2 inquiries. TikTok will mostly show the videos outside Karaganda. The test measures a cold start in November, not whether social media is useful to a B2B supplier. On top of that, the YES bar of '≥3 inquiries and 1 offer' is noise: a single existing client using a code can push it through, and an offer costs nothing to send. The verdict ends up random in both directions.
refutations.fix: Count only NEW clients (not in the CRM or the reps' lists) and require an invoice, not just an offer. Add a cheap control: the reps' forwarding arm, counted separately, and the 2GIS card with its own code. Then the decision covers 'which channel', not just 'video yes or no'. Word a NO as «органика нового аккаунта за 4 недели не дала», not «соцсети не нужны».

refutations.target: Format of the plan for me as the owner
refutations.why_fails: There are 7 ideas, 4 series, 16 DR rules, Thompson allocation and posteriors, mostly in English. Before I can say 'yes' I need one page in Russian: what we do, what it costs, what I give, when the answer comes. Otherwise I will drop it at the first weekly «да/нет».
refutations.fix: Before launch, a one-page summary in Russian: 3 numbers (cost, staff time, YES/NO threshold), 3 actions from me, the verdict date. The rest stays inside the agent.

refutations.target: Weekly approval: «не ответили до четверга — ролики не выходят»
refutations.why_fails: If I miss approval once or twice, the test fails as INCONCLUSIVE because of me, and that gets extended by another 2 weeks. That puts weight on the person least interested in the test.
refutations.fix: Approve the content rules and templates once. After that, only posts that contain facts, numbers or people need my explicit «да». Silence on the rest means they go out after 24 hours.

output.persona: veteran_creator: short-form creator and SMM for local businesses in Kazakhstan/CIS. Has run construction-supply and warehouse accounts in Karaganda, Almaty and Astana.
output.best_idea: Keep ID14 and the «Читаем мешок» format, but the strongest idea is one the plan doesn't have yet. Film the production date printed on the bag of a delivery that just arrived: «Свежая партия: смотрите дату на мешке». The camera can prove it, it doesn't depend on any ledger fact, and it answers a real foreman worry: old plaster that has caked or lost its properties. It is also local and timely, and it is very cheap to make: one close-up shot of about 6 seconds, around 2 minutes of staff time. The next strongest is ID14, as long as the message template ends with «Караганда, доставка на объект» once the owner confirms delivery. It is the only post whose CTA matches the verdict metric.

refutations.target: Whole slate / ledger defaults (no delivery, stock, city or what-we-sell claims until confirmed; owner checklist defaults to «нет»)
refutations.why_fails: Foremen in Karaganda message a supplier for 3 reasons: it's in stock, it's nearby and it delivers. Every one of those claims is blocked by default. That leaves 20 videos about pallet wrap and bag labels that never say «мы склад в Караганде, привозим на объект». A viewer has no reason to write, so the test will come out NO because the posts are empty, not because the market said no. The organic reach is a second problem. A new TikTok or Reels account gets shown across all of Kazakhstan and Russia. Out of 300 views, maybe 20–40 come from Karaganda, and ASMR-style wrap clips will pull in random viewers rather than local brigades.
refutations.fix: Make a 2-minute fact pack from the owner a blocking requirement in week 0, before any post goes out: own warehouse yes/no, delivery inside Karaganda yes/no, the 5 best-selling SKUs that are usually in stock. If he hasn't answered, ask again. Don't treat silence as «нет». Then put a fixed end card on every video and a matching bio line: «Сухие смеси и утеплитель · склад в Караганде · пишите материал и объём». Put «Караганда» in the on-screen text, the caption and the hashtags (#караганда #стройкакараганда #прорабкараганда). Where possible, shoot with local cues in frame, like snow on the gate or the street outside, so the platforms and the viewers read the posts as local.

refutations.target: Attribution via per-video typed codes ({CODE}) + verdict threshold
refutations.why_fails: Links in Reels and TikTok captions can't be clicked. A foreman will not type «ID13» into WhatsApp. He will call the number or write «скинь прайс на ротбанд». Coded chats will therefore undercount real inquiries several times over. Combined with a one-week baseline and a cold account, the verdict is tilted toward NO from the start.
refutations.fix: Use one wa.me link in the bio, prefilled with «Здравствуйте, я из TikTok/Instagram», one per platform. Show the phone number in large text on the end card. Count the verdict as all new company inquiries where «откуда узнали» = соцсети, either via a code or via the rep's question, with codes kept only as per-video detail. Add an Instagram auto-reply to a comment keyword («+» or «расчёт»). That brings in DMs you can count without anyone typing a code.

refutations.target: ID13 «Воду на глаз? Читаем мешок» (HERO series premise)
refutations.why_fails: This lectures brigades on something they've done for 20 years. In CIS construction comments, «мы на глаз мешаем 20 лет, учитель нашёлся» is the guaranteed reply, and the supplier ends up looking like a know-it-all, not a partner. It also breaks the plan's own «never mock brigades» rule in spirit. Production is the other problem: opening a bag, water, a bucket, a drill mixer, dust and cleanup won't fit in about 4 minutes. Realistically it's 15 or more minutes and a mess.
refutations.fix: Change the hero series so it reads labels and data for the foreman, not at him: «Расход на м² — сколько мешков на 100 м²?» and «Сколько стоит смесь при открытом мешке?». Make it a fast, numbers-first format: the foreman needs the figure for his estimate. The angle is «посчитаем за вас по паспорту», which also sets up the CTA. Shoot mixing only once, as a library clip, and reuse it.

refutations.target: ID02 film squeal / «Склад слышно» series
refutations.why_fails: Every warehouse and marketplace account already posts stretch-wrap ASMR. On a cold account it reaches ASMR viewers all over the CIS, not foremen. Even if it breaks out, it brings 0 inquiries, and then DR7 caps it in week 3. That spends 4 of 20 test slots on posts that can't add anything to the verdict.
refutations.fix: Cut it to 1 post in the whole test. Use the slot for the fresh-batch production-date video, or for a real-time loading video: «Собираем заказ на объект: 40 мешков штукатурки + утеплитель», which can be shot once delivery is confirmed. Both are just as sensory but carry a B2B signal.

refutations.target: ID10 POV «бригада на объекте, а машины нет»
refutations.why_fails: The POV dramatises a supplier being late. Then it cuts to our warehouse, but without any timing claim it promises nothing. So viewers see the pain next to our logo and no answer, and the brand ends up associated with the problem. The footage is also a mismatch: fingers drumming on a stack inside our warehouse are supposed to stand in for a foreman waiting on site.
refutations.fix: Run it only after the owner confirms some delivery fact, even a soft one («своими машинами по городу»). Otherwise keep it as a pure comment-bait question card («сколько вы ждали материал?») and leave the cut to our warehouse out.

refutations.target: ID19 / ID07 «Первый мороз» timing
refutations.why_fails: In Karaganda the first frosts usually come in late September or early October. By 10-19 «первый мороз» is old news, and anyone local will see that. The real moment in the test window is the first lasting snow, plus the shift to working «внутри, на тёплом контуре».
refutations.fix: Retitle it «Первый снег — переходим на внутренние работы» and trigger it on the weather fetch for the first snow cover. Shoot the B-roll as soon as it snows.

refutations.target: Staff time budget (≤17–20 min/week)
refutations.why_fails: The plan hides extra time outside the shoot card: a tally sheet at the gate, a weekly voice note, WhatsApp labels by whoever replies, a rep tally on every call, filming label texts, and a «свободное видео». The 15.2 minutes for 7 ideas in one session also assume no takes are wasted to forklift noise. In practice it's 30–40 minutes. DR14 then drops the plan to 3 posts a week and it drifts toward INCONCLUSIVE.
refutations.fix: Cut it to 3–4 worker shots a week, all at one location. Track only one habit, either the tally or the voice note, not both. Batch-shoot 2 weeks of B-roll in week 0, and let the AI build at least 2 of the 5 weekly posts from library footage.

refutations.target: Owner weekly approval with no-publish default
refutations.why_fails: A sceptical owner who has to answer one more message every Wednesday will miss 1–2 weeks. The no-reply-means-no-publish default turns his inattention into an INCONCLUSIVE result, and the plan itself points this out. Organic tests die this way all the time.
refutations.fix: Get the owner to approve the rails once, in week 0. After that, apply silent consent: posts with no prices and no new claims go out at 12:00 Thursday unless he says «стоп». Explicit approval stays required only for new facts, faces, offers or the volume number.

refutations.target: ID17 truck tally / no faces at all
refutations.why_fails: A count of trucks out of the gate is a small number. Without the owner's context it reads as weak, and he will probably veto it as confidential. More broadly, faceless B2B accounts get far fewer DMs. In Kazakhstan, people buy from «Ерлан со склада», not from hands.
refutations.fix: Swap ID17 for the fresh-batch production-date video. In Q3, offer the face option more concretely: one consenting storekeeper doing a 3-second «Пишите — посчитаю» on the end card. Show it as a separate test arm.

output.name: «Считаем по паспорту»: 4-week should-we-do-social test, revised (Karaganda, B2B dry mixes and insulation; Instagram + 2GIS first)
output.big_idea: A foreman's estimate depends on numbers already printed on the bag: consumption per m², layer thickness and how long the material keeps. A Karaganda warehouse that reads those numbers from the manufacturer's label on camera, does the bag count for his area and asks for one message («материал и площадь») is a supplier worth writing to. Episode supply: about 40 SKUs × several label lines gives more than 20 episodes. Proof on camera: the filmed label and the arithmetic done by hand on cardboard. Pointer to the measured action: «пришлите площадь — посчитаем». Every episode ends on the same local end card, so viewers and the platform read the account as a Karaganda supplier and not as generic warehouse content. Gate: no post goes out until the owner has answered the week-0 fact pack (own warehouse in Karaganda, delivery in Karaganda, 5 usually-stocked SKUs, the phone number, and whether the desk counts bags). Silence from the owner is never treated as «нет»; it blocks publishing and triggers reminders.
output.single_minded_message_ru: Пришлите площадь — посчитаем мешки по паспорту
output.why_this_wins:
This is not a forecast. The honest prior for a new Instagram account in one city in November is low: probably 0–3 new-client inquiries. The plan is built so that either answer, YES or NO, can be trusted. Here is how the revision changes the plan.

**1. Each post now gives a reason to write (fixes the fatal review point).**
- The old slate showed warehouse rituals but never said what is sold, where, or what happens when you write.
- Now a fact pack is blocking in week 0: own warehouse in Karaganda, delivery inside Karaganda, 5 usually-stocked SKUs, the phone number, and whether the desk counts bags from an area. Every post ends on a fixed card: «Сухие смеси и утеплитель · склад в Караганде · пишите материал и объём». The bio, caption, hashtags and location tag carry the same line.
- Outdoor shots show local cues (gate, yard, snow).
- A NO can therefore come from the market, not from empty posts.

**2. The hero is now a service, not a lecture.** I03 (E16, E17, E19) plus I02 (E04, E25): reading the label for the foreman and counting his bags turns the message into the CTA. ID13's «вода на глаз» shortcut and its «постановка» are retired, because brigades would read them as being taught their own job. Mixing is shot at most once, as a library clip.

**3. Attribution matches how foremen actually behave.**
- One prefilled wa.me link in the bio per platform: «Здравствуйте, я из Instagram. Материал: … Площадь/объём: …».
- The phone number in large text on the end card.
- A comment keyword «расчёт» that sends an auto-DM.
- Reps ask new callers one question: «Откуда узнали?».
- Per-video codes are kept as per-video detail only.
- The verdict counts every NEW company that came from social media, by any route. This removes the strong NO bias that typed codes alone would create.

**4. The verdict cannot be pushed through by noise.**
- Only companies not already in the CRM or the reps' lists count, and at least one invoice (not just an offer) must be issued to one of them.
- Two control arms are counted separately on the same per-hour basis: rep forwarding (if approved) and a 2GIS link with its own prefill.
- The final decision is therefore 'which channel, at what cost per hour', not just 'video: yes or no'.
- A NO is worded «органика нового аккаунта за 4 недели не дала».

**5. Cost is counted honestly.**
- One sheet records every minute: cards, the voice note, the desk's labelling and replies, the reps' question, setup one-offs and the owner's minutes. The verdict is calculated per total hour.
- The truck tally (ID17) is dropped. Each chat gets one label. Weekly cards are capped at 3–4 shots in one location. The agent edits at least 2 of the 5 weekly posts from week-0 library footage.

**6. Reputation risks removed.**
- ID10 (late-truck POV) is held until delivery facts exist and the owner says «да».
- Frost is filmed only outside (gate, yard, sky), and stock only indoors.
- ID02 (wrap sound) runs once in the whole test.

**Learning plan**
- About 20 Instagram posts in the shared driver and format slugs, pooled into the b2b_construction_materials vertical.
- TikTok and Shorts are added only if Instagram shows life by the end of week 2.
- Instagram audience-city share is tracked, to check the reach is actually local.

**METHOD gaps (judgment)**
- F3 has no mix for should_we_do_social. Used: about 50% hero utility, 30% conversion questions, 20% reach and moment probes.
- Standing owner approval with silent consent is used only if the owner opts in once (L8 is kept as a one-time human decision).

series.name: Считаем по паспорту
series.role:
HERO. Consideration → conversion. Metrics: saves/1k, and messages that include an area or volume per 1k views (the verdict proxy).
- **Opening ritual:** frame 1 is a finger already on the consumption or storage line of a real bag label, filmed indoors. The hook is generated at edit time under the rails, e.g. «Сколько мешков на вашу площадь? Считаем».
- **Fixed structure:** label line read verbatim from the ledger → hands do the arithmetic on cardboard for an example area, labelled «пример» → result card «расчёт по данным производителя» → the fixed Karaganda end card with {CODE} and the phone number.
- **Episode variable:** the SKU or the label line: consumption per m², layer thickness, how long an opened bag keeps (only if the label states it), pot life.
- **No shortcut-shaming:** ID13's «на глаз» opening and its «постановка» are retired. A mixing clip is used only if one was filmed once in week 0, and then reused.
- **Cost:** each episode is ≤3 staff minutes at «склад», or 0 minutes when built from week-0 label B-roll.
- **Episode 7 test:** «Утеплитель: сколько упаковок на стену?» A stranger could guess it and would still watch.
- Every figure is a NEEDS FACT until the filmed label is in the ledger.
series.cadence: 2 per week from week 1, at least 1 of them built from library footage. Thompson allocation may change this from week 3.

series.name: Вопрос из WhatsApp
series.role:
Conversion. Metric: social-sourced new-company inquiries per 1k views, and saves/1k.
- **Opening ritual:** thumbs already typing in frame 1, or an anonymised question card. Hook: «Нам пишут: …» or a call-out to the buyer type.
- **ID14** is the message template and is pinned as «как заказать». Its fields match the bio prefill: материал, площадь/объём, район объекта, компания/ИП.
- **Later episodes** use the ID07 wa_question template with questions from the rep's list. Only questions the rep marked as asked ≥2 times are used, and always paraphrased.
- **ID07's frost question** runs only in a real-frost week, with frost filmed outside the warehouse.
series.cadence: 1 per week. ID14 in week 1. ID07 or another rep-list question from week 2.

series.name: Ответ на комментарий
series.role:
Participation and retention. Metric: comments/1k and follows.
- **Opening ritual:** a real public comment card (username blurred) slides in over library footage.
- **Cost:** zero staff minutes.
- **Facts:** the answer uses only ledger facts. Comments asking «а сколько мешков на…» are answered as «Считаем по паспорту» episodes, so this series feeds the hero.
series.cadence: 1 per week from week 2, only if a usable real comment exists. Otherwise the slot goes to the hero.

series.name: Разовые пробы (не серия)
series.role:
Reach and moment probes with a strict cap, so they cannot use up the test.
- **ID02 (wrap sound):** 1 post in the whole test. Caption carries a buyer question and the post ends on the Karaganda end card.
- **ID19 (first frost):** only in the actual first-frost week. Frost is filmed on the gate, yard or sky; stock appears only indoors.
- **Metric:** views_48h ÷ median, and Karaganda share of reached accounts.
- **Held:** ID10 is held (see decision rules).
series.cadence: ID02: once (week 1). ID19: once, in the frost week. ID10: 0 until released by its rule.

channels.channel: Instagram Reels + profile (the only video platform in weeks 1–2)
channels.role:
Main test bed and shop window.
- **Account:** created by the WhatsApp desk person with the owner's «да» (about 20 min, counted in the total-time sheet).
- **Bio** (after the fact pack): «Сухие смеси и утеплитель · склад в Караганде · пишите материал и объём», plus one wa.me link prefilled with «Здравствуйте, я из Instagram. Материал: … Площадь/объём: …».
- **Every post:** location tag Караганда, with #караганда #стройкакараганда #прорабкараганда in the caption (used, never tested).
- **Pins:** ID14 («как заказать»), the best «Считаем по паспорту» episode, and the best proof post.
- **Highlights:** «Как заказать» and «Склад». No «Цены».
- **Hook variants** go to Trial Reels where available.
- **Comment keyword «расчёт»** triggers an auto-DM with the template (owner-approved text). «+» is not used, because D6 bans it as bait.
- Commercial-library music only.

Fixed local card for the last 2 seconds: «Сухие смеси и утеплитель · склад в Караганде · пишите материал и объём», the phone number in large text, and {CODE}.
- **Gating:** every element needs its fact-pack id. Without the fact pack, nothing publishes.
- **Judgment deviation from D6:** D6 keeps phone numbers out of cta_ru. Here the number goes on the end card only, as a ledger fact, because foremen call rather than type codes.

Where most inquiries land.
- **Quick reply** (owner approves once): «Здравствуйте! Вы из Instagram/по видео {CODE}. Подскажите: компания или ИП, какой материал и площадь или объём — посчитаем количество и передадим менеджеру по наличию и условиям.» The «посчитаем» wording is used only if fact-pack item 5 = да.
- **Codeless chats:** «Подскажите, откуда о нас узнали?»
- **Private buyers:** a polite reply following the owner's rule. Counted separately, never qualified.
- **One label only:** «Соцсети», on any chat that came via a code, the prefill or «из инстаграма» (about 0.5 min per chat, counted).
- **Guardrail:** median first reply ≤15 min in working hours. Over 60 min is reported as the top leak, and conversion posts pause.

channels.channel: Sales reps: «Откуда узнали?» + forwarding control arm
channels.role:
**One question only:** reps ask NEW company callers «Откуда узнали?» and write «соцсети / 2ГИС / другое» in their existing notes (about 0.5 min per new caller, counted).
- **Forwarding arm** (only with the owner's «да»): reps forward the week's best video to prospects under a separate code family. Their minutes and resulting inquiries are reported as their own channel per hour, not as organic.
- **Week 4 one-off review** (about 5 min): the rep marks which social-labelled chats are new companies (not in the CRM or their lists) and which received an invoice.

The desk claims or verifies the card. The agent refreshes its photos with real indoor stock and outdoor gate shots (no plates, no faces). It gets its own WhatsApp link prefilled «Здравствуйте, я из 2ГИС», and its inquiries are reported per hour as a cheap comparison channel. Review requests go out only after the owner approves the text, and are never incentivised.

Added only if Instagram shows life by 2026-11-08: ≥1 social-sourced new-company inquiry, OR median shares+saves/1k ≥ the pooled median, OR Karaganda ≥30% of reached accounts. Setup is about 15 desk minutes (counted) plus 1 owner tap. Each platform has its own prefilled bio link and is judged against its own baseline. TikTok reach is expected to be mostly outside Karaganda, so the local end card and city text matter even more there.
Off. Contact with existing clients needs the owner's explicit «да», would be a separate code family, and is excluded from the new-client verdict.

None during the test (0 ₸): the verdict must reflect organic reach. After a YES, a boost of DR2 posts can be proposed with cap CPQC = avg_order × gross_margin × close_rate × 0.3 and a stop-loss at 5× the cap with fewer than 3 coded chats. The inputs are NEEDS FACT.

weeks.goal:
Setup, 2026-10-12 → 10-25 (two calendar weeks, because the timeline shifts by one week). No posts.
- **Owner:** one batched message today (≤12 min). Answer deadline 10.14 12:00, i.e. 3 working days.
- **Fact pack is BLOCKING:** reminders go out on 10.14 and 10.16, and silence is never read as «нет». If it is still unanswered on 10.23, week 1 slips and the whole calendar moves with it.
- **Desk:** creates Instagram and claims 2GIS after the owner's «да».
- **Rep:** writes the list of the 10 most frequent questions with rough counts (about 10 min). Does a one-off retro count of new companies invoiced in August–September (about 5 min) to set the baseline of new clients per week.
- **Staff, session 1 (Tue 10.13, about 10 min):** reality scan.
- **Staff, session 2 (Tue 10.20, about 12 min):** a 2-week B-roll bank at «склад»: label lines on 5 usually-stocked SKUs, the wrap squeal, bags indoors, the gate and yard outside (local cue), and the typing demo.
- **Agent:** opens the total-time sheet, with every minute logged from day 1.
weeks.worker_ask_ru: Здравствуйте, это AI-ассистент. Две короткие съёмки. decision_rules: FACT-PACK GATE: no post publishes until the fact pack is answered (own warehouse in Karaganda, delivery in Karaganda, 5 usually-stocked SKUs, the phone number, whether the desk counts bags). Silence is never «нет». The agent re-asks on 10.14 and 10.16. If it is unanswered by 10.23, every date shifts by 1 week. An answer of «нет» to «посчитаем» changes the end card and message to «пишите материал и объём» and drops the counting promise.

PUBLISHING CONSENT: if the owner opts in once to standing approval of the rails, posts with no prices, no new facts, no faces, no offers and no volume numbers publish Thursday 12:00 after a Wednesday preview unless he writes «стоп». Anything new still needs an explicit «да». Two «стоп» in the test revert to explicit weekly approval. Without the opt-in, publishing needs his explicit «да» each week.
DR1 Read: every post at 48 h and 7 days, on each platform against its own baseline.

DR2 Breakout: ≥3× the platform median at 48 h (≈ ≥900 views on the 300-view [ASSUMPTION], replaced by the own last-15 median after 10 posts), or shares+saves/1k ≥2× the median.
- Within 7 days, 2 follow-ups that replace planned slots, so the card stays ≤3–4 shots.
- Pin it if it is conversion-relevant.
- No boost during the test.
- At ≥10× (≈ ≥3,000 views) it becomes a series, reported as a tail event, not a plan.
DR3 Hook failure: 3-s hold <0.7× the account median → re-cut with a different first frame and hook, repost ≥7 days later, once only.
DR4 Body failure: hold OK but completion <0.7× the median → shorten and move the result card earlier in the next episode.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss: by the end of week 3, cumulative views ≥8,000 (≈15 posts × 300 × 1.8) but <2 social-sourced messages from all routes → before more content, check the end card, the bio prefill link, the keyword auto-DM, whether reps are asking «Откуда узнали?», and reply time.
Reply guardrail: median first reply in working hours >60 min → reported as the top leak, and conversion posts pause until it is ≤15 min.
DR6 Sales-handling miss: ≥3 new qualified companies but 0 invoices → report where those chats stopped and draft reply scripts. Price and terms stay the owner's call.

PLATFORM EXPANSION (11.08): add TikTok and Shorts only if Instagram has ≥1 social-sourced new-company inquiry, OR median shares+saves/1k ≥ the pooled median, OR Karaganda ≥30% of reached accounts. Otherwise stay Instagram-only and save the setup minutes.
ID10 RELEASE: the late-truck POV stays held until delivery facts are ledger ids AND the owner explicitly says «да» to this video. If that never happens, it never runs and the slot goes to the hero.
FROST RULE: frost or snow is filmed only outside (gate, yard, sky). Stock and bags appear only indoors. Any clip showing frost on our pallets or film is discarded.
REACH CAP: ID02 wrap sound runs once in the whole test. Other sound clips are allowed only as B-roll inside hero or question episodes.

TIME BUDGET: staff ≤20 min/week (card ≤3–4 shots in 1 location, plus the 30-s voice note). Desk and rep incremental time is logged rather than capped, because it rises with inquiries. If staff time exceeds 20 min in a week, the next card drops to 3 shots and the agent builds 3 of the 5 posts from the library. The verdict always uses the TOTAL hours.
Private buyers: if they are >50% of social-sourced chats for 2 weeks → add the owner's routing line to captions and the quick reply. Never qualified.
DR10 Capacity: if reps cannot process new qualified inquiries within 1 working day, or the owner says trucks or the warehouse are full → pause conversion CTAs and shift to hero utility only.
DR11 Honesty kill-switch: a comment credibly disputes a fact (e.g. a label reading) or claims a bad delivery → pause that series, verify, and tell the owner the same day. Never argue in comments.
DR13 Claims: no arm is called a 'winner' (n<10 per arm). Report «лидирует, рано судить» with an interval.
DR15 Owner: rejections >30% of a batch → read the reasons and update the constraints. A fact rejection means fixing the ledger.
DR16: never delete flops, except for truth, consent or legal problems.

VERDICT (pre-registered, 2026-11-23):
- **YES:** new qualified companies from social media ≥ the threshold (default 3) AND ≥1 invoice to one of them → the next sprint is b2b_leads.
- **NO:** below the threshold with ≥15 posts → stop video. Owner wording: «органика нового аккаунта за 4 недели не дала». Keep 2GIS and a static profile, and offer a spring re-test.
- **INCONCLUSIVE:** fewer than 15 posts → extend by 2 weeks, once.
- **Always reported:** per-hour results for the 2GIS and rep-forwarding controls, so the owner chooses a channel, not just yes or no to video.

NEEDS FACT (blocking, owner): 5 usually-stocked SKUs, used only as material names, never as «в наличии».

NEEDS FACT (staff film + agent ledger): verbatim label lines (consumption, layer, storage, pot life) for every hero episode. Example areas are labelled «пример», and the truth rail may still query them.

NEEDS FACT (owner): average order value, gross margin and close rate, needed before any post-verdict boost cap can be computed.

Low prior: a new account in one city in November most likely yields 0–3 new-company inquiries. The test is designed so a NO is cheap and honestly worded («органика нового аккаунта за 4 недели не дала»), not a judgement on social media in general.
Timeline: if the owner answers the fact pack late, every date shifts by a week, deeper into winter. The fact pack is chased on 10.14 and 10.16 and never assumed.

Total-time honesty: the desk's per-chat minutes (0.5 for labelling, 5 for replies) are [ASSUMPTION] until checked with the desk in week 2. A big inquiry week raises the denominator, which is correct and intended.

Arm label mismatch: ID13 keeps its step-4 slugs (myth_check / curiosity_gap) although the reworked episodes behave like check_before_buy / practical_value. That pollutes pooled arms. NEXT BATCH: re-log the numbers-first hero as a new idea with the correct slugs.
End card shows a phone number: a judgment deviation from D6 (cta_ru stays without numbers), because foremen call rather than type codes. The number is used only as a ledger fact.

The comment-to-DM automation on Instagram may need a Meta-approved third-party tool [ASSUMPTION]. If unavailable, the caption asks people to write «расчёт» in DM instead. «+» is never used (D6 bait ban).
Instagram-only weeks 1–2 rule out using platforms as blocks for hook variants. Variants go to Trial Reels where available, or are deferred.
TikTok reach, if added, will mostly be outside Karaganda. Verdict counts only Karaganda-serviceable companies; the local end card and city text are the mitigation.
Reputation: comments may raise real past delivery complaints regardless. DR11 applies (pause, verify, tell the owner the same day, never argue in public). ID10 stays held.
Frost footage: any clip showing frost on stock is discarded, and stock appears only indoors. «Тёплый/сухой склад» is never claimed unless it is a ledger fact.
B2B confidentiality: no client names, sites, tender details, prices, documents or vehicle plates. Rep-anonymised inputs only. Raw text stays internal.
Private buyers may arrive via the prefill or keyword. They are routed by the owner's rule and excluded from the verdict.
Seasonality: a NO in November means 'no for this winter', and a spring re-test is offered.
Safety: no staff performance. If the mixing clip is shot, gloves on and the phone on a stand.

output.persona: Владелец гипотетического поставщика стройматериалов в Караганде (сухие смеси, утеплитель, продаём только компаниям). К соцсетям отношусь скептически: время менеджеров и склада для меня дороже любых просмотров.
output.best_idea: На мой вопрос план отвечает честно: «не знаем, проверим за 4 недели, порог заранее, при неудаче — стоп». Полезнее всего три вещи. Первая — привести в порядок карточку в 2ГИС со своей ссылкой в WhatsApp. Вторая — чтобы менеджеры у каждого нового клиента спрашивали «Откуда узнали?». Третья — сделать рекламной фразой услугу «Пришлите площадь — посчитаем мешки». Это работает и без роликов: даже при итоге «НЕТ» у меня остаются витрина в 2ГИС и данные о том, откуда приходят новые клиенты. Ещё хорошо, что ролик с опозданием машины придержали, нет цен и лиц, и решение «нет» сформулировано без потери лица: «органика нового аккаунта за 4 недели не дала».

refutations.target: Обещание по времени: «до 20 минут в неделю у сотрудника и до 5 минут у вас»
refutations.why_fails: В разных частях плана разные цифры. В резюме — 80 минут на всё, в замерах — около 130 минут вместе с 70 минутами подготовки. Сверх этого идут: ответы в WhatsApp по 5 минут на каждый чат, по 0,5 минуты на метку, 20 минут на заведение аккаунта, 22 минуты съёмок в нулевую неделю, 10+5+5 минут менеджера. В первую неделю ещё и погрузчик просят остановить на 10 минут, а это уже простой склада, и он нигде не учтён. Мне продали «20 минут», а на деле нагрузка ложится на троих и растёт с каждым обращением.
refutations.fix: Одна строка в первом сообщении мне: «всего ≈130–180 мин за 6 недель на всех, вот разбивка по людям». Погрузчик не останавливать, снимать в обед или после смены. Потолок по времени для менеджеров записать заранее, а не только считать его по факту.

refutations.target: Сроки и порог итога расходятся между документами
refutations.why_fails: В резюме итог 16.11, в кампании 23.11. «Нулевая неделя» на деле длится две недели. В резюме стоят «закодированные обращения», а в кампании засчитывается любой путь, включая слова «из соцсетей». Скептику с такими расхождениями проще всего сказать «вы сами не знаете, что меряете».
refutations.fix: Одна дата итога (23.11) и одно определение засчитанного обращения во всех текстах для меня и персонала. Старую версию убрать.

refutations.target: Итог «ДА» = 3 новые компании и 1 счёт
refutations.why_fails: Один счёт на 15 мешков от бригады с ИП формально даёт «ДА» и запускает следующий спринт b2b_leads, то есть постоянную нагрузку на людей. Нижней границы по сумме или марже нет. При трёх случаях это шум: одного случайного клиента, который «видел в инсте», хватит, чтобы повернуть решение в любую сторону.
refutations.fix: Добавить в критерий «ДА» минимальную сумму: суммарные счета новым клиентам ≥ N ₸, N называю я. Решение «ДА» сформулировать как «продолжаем ещё 4 недели с тем же порогом», а не «запускаем лидогенерацию».

refutations.target: Главная рубрика «Считаем по паспорту» и обещание «посчитаем мешки»
refutations.why_fails: Прорабу читают вслух этикетку, которую он сам читает 20 лет. Есть риск выглядеть как «учим бригаду их работе», от чего план сам отказался в ID13. Кроме того, «посчитаем» означает ответственность. Недосчитали — бригада стоит, виноват поставщик. Пересчитали — клиент решит, что мы навязываем лишнее. Ни запаса на отходы, ни оговорки в плане нет.
refutations.fix: В каждом расчёте подпись «ориентировочно, по данным производителя, без учёта основания и отходов, окончательно — менеджер». Акцент сместить с «читаем этикетку» на «вы пишете площадь — мы присылаем расчёт и счёт». Перед запуском проверить на двух знакомых прорабах, не выглядит ли это снисходительно.

refutations.target: «≈40 позиций × несколько строк на этикетке = больше 20 выпусков»
refutations.why_fails: В ведомости пусто, сколько у меня позиций, никто не знает. Число 40 выдумано. Если обещанные 20+ выпусков не наберутся, рубрика заглохнет на третьей неделе.
refutations.fix: Считать выпуски от 5 ходовых позиций из пакета фактов. Честный запас — 10–15 выпусков, на остальное есть ответы на комментарии.

refutations.target: Сложность для моих людей (Thompson, DR1–DR16, Trial Reels, сводные медианы, 5 вопросов о данных)
refutations.why_fails: Для 20 роликов это перебор. Семь пунктов в первом сообщении мне, шесть из которых блокируют запуск, — это не «одно короткое сообщение». Тут велик риск, что я просто не отвечу, и тест сам перейдёт в «НЕ ЯСНО».
refutations.fix: Мне — максимум 3 вопроса: порог, пакет фактов, «да» на аккаунты. Остальное принять по умолчанию и показать одной строкой «если не против — молчание = ок» (кроме фактов). Правила решений держать у себя и не присылать.

refutations.target: Instagram как главный канал, 2ГИС только как «контрольная группа»
refutations.why_fails: В Караганде B2B-закупщик ищет поставщика в 2ГИС, на Satu.kz и по сарафанному радио, а не в ленте. Карточка 2ГИС с фото, часами работы и WhatsApp — самое дешёвое, что вообще может дать результат, а здесь она во второй роли. Satu.kz и WhatsApp-каталог не упомянуты вовсе.
refutations.fix: Сделать 2ГИС (и, если подходит, Satu.kz или каталог в WhatsApp Business) основной витриной в нулевую неделю, это около 30 минут один раз. Instagram — проверочная ветка поверх витрины. В итоге сравнивать стоимость часа по каждому каналу.

refutations.target: Автоответ на слово «расчёт» в комментариях
refutations.why_fails: В самом плане сказано, что для этого может понадобиться сторонний сервис (ManyChat и т.п.). Бесплатный тариф ограничен, а бюджет 0 ₸. Ещё один инструмент, который кто-то будет настраивать.
refutations.fix: Убрать. Хватит ссылки wa.me в профиле и номера телефона на концовке.

refutations.target: Ролик со звуком плёнки (ID02) и съёмка заморозков
refutations.why_fails: Звук плёнки ничего не продаёт: это просмотры не из Караганды и не от покупателей. Заморозки в последнюю неделю октября не гарантированы, слот будет висеть.
refutations.fix: ID02 заменить вторым роликом «как заказать» или «дата изготовления на мешке». Заморозки снимать только если они уже есть на улице, а не держать для них место.

refutations.target: Первая съёмка 13.10 раньше, чем я отвечу (срок 14.10)
refutations.why_fails: Склад тратит время на «скан реальности» до того, как я согласился на тест вообще.
refutations.fix: Перенести первую съёмку на день после моего «да». Если нужно, сдвинуть даты на 2–3 дня.

output.persona: veteran_creator: short-form creator and SMM for local businesses in Kazakhstan and the CIS, focused on what one weak phone can shoot in 20 minutes and what actually brings inquiries in Karaganda
output.best_idea: The «Вопрос из WhatsApp» series (ID07 and the questions from the rep's list). Real questions that clients have asked at least twice, filmed on real bags, with a frost or storage moment. This is the only format that speaks to a brigade lead in his own words, and it is cheap to shoot. It also turns into an inquiry naturally («а у вас есть под минус?»). ID14 is fine as a pinned «как заказать» post, but it should not count as one of the distribution posts.

refutations.target: Hero series «Считаем по паспорту» (single-minded message «Пришлите площадь — посчитаем мешки»)
refutations.why_fails: A foreman or brigade lead does not need a warehouse to count bags. He counts them on his phone in 10 seconds and knows the consumption figures from practice. Area-to-bags content and 'how much do I need' calculations are what DIY builders and private buyers look for, and the plan excludes them from the verdict. The hero series will pull people doing their own apartment renovation into WhatsApp. They are counted as unqualified, they use up the desk's time, and the denominator grows. On top of that, reading the label line and doing arithmetic on cardboard is visually a lecture: zero stop power, and a pro scrolls past.
refutations.fix: Keep the label, but change the angle to the pro's real pain: what is actually in stock in Karaganda right now, which brand and SKU, and in what volume. Hook: «Ceresit CT 17 / Knauf Ротбанд / Технониколь — что сейчас на складе в Караганде» (using the 5 SKUs from the fact pack, without promising stock: «обычно держим»). The pallet with the brand name in frame 1, the brand in the caption and hashtags (people search by brand), and the CTA «пишите позицию и объём». Keep counting as a quick-reply service in WhatsApp, not as content.

refutations.target: Distribution: a new Instagram account in one city with 0 ₸ and no seeding (rep forwarding is off by default)
refutations.why_fails: A new B2B account in Karaganda will get 100–300 views on most posts, and most of those viewers will not be in Karaganda. At these numbers the verdict is NO almost by construction. That NO says nothing about whether video works for this company. It only says no seeding was done. In Kazakhstan, foremen and brigades live in WhatsApp groups, Telegram chats («Стройка Караганда», прорабы, бригады ищут работу) and on 2GIS. Real local businesses start their first views exactly there.
refutations.fix: Make seeding part of the main arm, not an option. Each post goes into 2–3 local WhatsApp or Telegram builder chats (owner-approved list, about 2 min a week for the desk, logged). Staff and reps put it in their own WhatsApp Status. Use a separate code family so it can be counted. Rep forwarding to their own contacts can stay a control arm, but switch it on by default and ask the owner for a «нет», not a «да».

refutations.target: Owner onboarding: 7 asks in one batched message, with numbered options, a fact pack that blocks publishing, and reminders
refutations.why_fails: A skeptical owner with a limit of 5 minutes a week gets a mini-contract with 20+ decisions about thresholds, «стоп» rules, auto-DMs and chat export. In real life he will reply «давайте потом» or answer only the first two points. Because the fact pack blocks publishing, the plan's main risk is that nothing ever starts. The calendar has already slipped once (intake says 10-19 → 11-15, the campaign says 10-26 → 11-22), and every reminder pushes it a week deeper into winter.
refutations.fix: First message: only 3 questions, answered «да/нет» plus one line. (1) Is the warehouse yours and in Karaganda, and which number goes in the videos? (2) Name 5 items that are always in stock. (3) Shall we start with Instagram and 2ГИС on 26.10, no faces and no prices? Everything else (threshold, private buyers, templates, forwarding) runs on defaults with an «если против — напишите» line, and goes into a second message after the first videos are live. Align the dates with the intake.

refutations.target: ID14 «Прораб, ИП или закупщик? Пишите так» counted as a weekly post
refutations.why_fails: It is an instruction on how to write to us, which is advertising. Nobody saves or forwards a template for writing to a supplier they do not know yet. As a pinned post it works; as one of the 5 weekly posts it is a wasted slot that pulls the views median down.
refutations.fix: Pin it once in week 1 and do not count it toward the 15 posts needed for the verdict. Use the slot for one more real question from the rep's list.

refutations.target: Staff card «погрузчик на 10 минут остановить», plus cardboard arithmetic plus talk in one 8-minute session
refutations.why_fails: Stopping the forklift during the working day costs the warehouse real money, and the plan does not count that cost. Writing on cardboard and filming hands with one weak phone at 30 cm means focus problems and retakes. In practice it will take 15–20 minutes, not 8. In week 0 the staff need about 22 minutes in a single week, which already breaks the 20-minute limit.
refutations.fix: Shoot when the forklift is idle anyway (before opening or at lunch). Drop the cardboard and show the result as a text card in the edit. Split the week-0 bank into two sessions of 10 minutes or less in different weeks, or reduce it to 3 SKUs.

refutations.target: ID02 wrap sound and ID19 first frost as reach probes
refutations.why_fails: The wrap ASMR gets views from everywhere except Karaganda foremen, so it brings no inquiries and pulls Karaganda's share of the audience down. The first frost in Karaganda usually comes in October, so by 26.10 the 'moment' has probably already passed, and a 'first frost' post in November looks stale.
refutations.fix: Use ID02 only as B-roll and drop it as a standalone post. Turn ID19 into «Работаете зимой внутри? Что берут бригады в ноябре», tied to the season rather than to the first frost.

refutations.target: «расчёт» comment keyword → auto-DM at 0 ₸
refutations.why_fails: Instagram auto-DMs need ManyChat or a similar tool. The free tier has limits, setup takes 30+ minutes, and the desk will not manage it alone. Foremen in Kazakhstan do not type keywords anyway; they write «сколько?» or «есть?» in the comments, or they call.
refutations.fix: Drop the auto-DM. The desk replies to comments by hand with one template. The phone number and the wa.me link on the end card already carry the conversion.
